subject: Platform stability reconciliation — credit & trial extension request
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@greenweave.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@greenweave.io>, support@greenweave.io
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — impact and credits request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. To recap from our side: between 03:30–07:10 PT this morning we saw elevated latencies (200%+ p95) and occasional 503s for our real-time recommendation endpoint. This impacted a large fraction of our production traffic and caused backpressure that led to ~2 hours of downstream queueing for our batch pipeline.

We collected logs and timestamps (attaching a small packet capture/latency sample). Our billing period is mid-month and we were in the middle of a marketing push — this incident directly cost us staff-hours and customer complaints. Given the impact, we'd like Redwood to propose a remediation path: a goodwill credit to cover the affected window and a trial extension so we can validate the promised stability before committing further spend.

Requested:
- A credit equivalent to the tokens consumed during the impacted window (or a negotiated flat credit)
- A 60-day trial extension for our expanded evaluation cluster (currently scheduled to expire 2026-12-31)

Please let us know next steps and any logs you need.

—Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Integrations, GreenWeave
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@greenweave.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — impact and credits request

Hi Elena — thank you for the clear summary and for sending the logs. I'm really sorry for the disruption this morning. We're treating this as a priority.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- Hannah and Stephanie are looping in SRE to validate the traces and confirm the root cause.
- I'll draft an initial compensation proposal for GreenWeave and circulate for approval.
- We'll provide an incident summary and a suggested credit memo by EOD PST.

Proposed short-term remediation (subject to approval):
- Goodwill credit: $8,750 (covers compute and support hours for impacted window).
- Trial extension: 60 days on the expanded evaluation cluster (new expiry 2027-02-28).

If that looks reasonable, we'll prepare the credit memo and DocuSign. If you prefer token-based credit we can translate the dollar amount into token units and include that in the memo.

I'll keep you posted as Hannah confirms root cause.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — impact and credits request

Looping in for approval and to confirm the ask. Quick notes: 
- GreenWeave is a mid-sized prospect with a POC spend of ~$40k/month. We should be generous enough to preserve momentum but keep the offer bounded.
- My recommendation: approve the $8.75k credit + 60-day extension, and add a one-time 20% promotional discount on January usage up to $10k. This gives them runway and ties us to their success in Q1.

Hannah / Stephanie — can you confirm whether the attached logs indicate a platform OOM vs. a transient region routing issue? If it's our edge routing, we need to flag for wider SRE review.

—Lauren
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — impact and credits request

Quick diagnostic notes (summary):
- Reviewed the latency samples and trace IDs. Root cause: transient autoscaler looped incorrectly during a burst of short-lived sessions — we saw KV cache thrashing on the serving nodes in us-west-2. This caused elevated p95 and occasional 503s as load briefly exceeded the warm-up window.
- Not an OOM; it's a scaling/routing policy edge case. We've got a mitigation in flight (adjusted warm-up config and KV cache persistence tweak).
- SRE has pushed a config change and is monitoring; preliminary metrics show p95 returning to normal within ~20 minutes after the mitigation deploy.

Recommendation: approve the proposed goodwill package. I'll attach the incident summary and a list of affected trace IDs. Suggest including a small token uplift for testing of their replay window (we can add a 25k-token test bundle).

—Hannah
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena@greenweave.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@greenweave.io>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — impact and credits request

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagnostic, Hannah. The mitigation looks good from our side — latency is back to expected ranges and our batch pipelines drained overnight. We appreciate the proposed package. 

A couple of clarifications before we finalize:
- Can the $8,750 credit be issued as token units instead of dollars? If so, please specify the token conversion and expiry for the credit.
- Confirmation that the 60-day trial extension will apply to the exact same expanded cluster config (we rely on the same quotas).

If you can send the final credit memo and the DocuSign link, we'll sign quickly.

—Elena
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@greenweave.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden inference failures this morning — credit memo & trial extension — approved

Elena — thank you and glad to hear things are stable. Officially approved:
- Goodwill credit: $8,750 translated to 175,000 token units (conversion rate: $0.05 per 1,000 tokens). Credit expiry: 12 months from issue.
- Trial extension: 60 days on the same expanded cluster config; we will preserve quotas and feature flags exactly as-is. New expiry date: 2027-02-28.
- One-time promotional: 20% discount on January 2027 usage up to $10k (applies automatically at invoice).
- Bonus: 25,000 token test bundle for replay testing, added to the credit memo.

Attachments: incident-summary-redwood-20261209.pdf (root cause & mitigation), credit-memo-GW-20261209.csv (line items), greenweave_latency_logs_120926.zip (raw traces). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/preview/GW-Credit-2026

Aditya — will you trigger the DocuSign and update the HubSpot deal with the credit record? Hannah — please keep monitoring and flag if we see recurrence.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
